verdict.rationale: Porkbun ships an official MCP server (`npx @porkbunllc/mcp-server`, 96 tools) that it explicitly markets for plain-language operation from Claude, Cursor or any MCP client. It gives a concrete natural-language command example covering registration, DNS pointing and auto-renew. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, and a native in-product natural-language interface (it relies on an external MCP client/LLM).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask in plain language; it registers domains, edits DNS, provisions hosting and moves zones to Cloudflare for you.
npx @porkbunllc/mcp-server — 96 tools for Claude, Cursor and any MCP client.
Register skaboink.dev if it's under $20, point it at my server, and turn auto-renew on.
